BrandPage.title: Our Story
BrandPage.description: CATDOW began with a practical question: when cats become part of a household, can the objects they need belong to the home's order and character?
paragraphs: People and cats share more than floor area. They share daily routes, familiar corners and the time spent together. We begin with these lived moments to reconsider what pet furniture can be.
CATDOW is still at an early stage. Rather than define the brand through unverified numbers or labels, we are establishing clear product records, design methods and information standards first.
This website is a starting point. Public information will grow as products complete validation, and every material, dimension and feature statement will follow confirmed documentation.
BrandPage.statement: A home is neither a backdrop for people nor a container for pets.
BrandPage.statementBody: It is a life shared. CATDOW brings both scales onto the same drawing.

DesignPage.title: Design Philosophy
DesignPage.description: We consider feline behaviour, human routines and the spatial life of a home together. Functions are clear, expression is restrained and information remains verifiable.

methods.title: Observe life before drawing objects
methods.text: We begin with the routes, resting places and interactions shared by cats and people, then decide what the piece should do.

methods.title: Work at two scales
methods.text: Cats need places to climb, pause and feel secure. People consider cleaning, circulation and the room as a whole. Both must work.

methods.title: Make structure understandable
methods.text: Modules, accessories and care methods are recorded clearly in each product file. Unconfirmed information stays off public pages.

methods.title: Keep the visual language restrained
methods.text: Form, colour and material must work within a real home, not only in a single product image.
